articles.headline: U.S. strike on an alleged drug boat kills 1, leaves 2 survivors
articles.summary: The U.S. military attacked a boat accused of smuggling drugs in the eastern Pacific Ocean on Tuesday, killing one man and leaving two survivors. This brings the number of people who have been killed in boat strikes to at least 208.
articles._summary: President Donald Trump speaks during a Cabinet meeting at the White House, Wednesday, May 27, 2026, in Washington, as Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, looks on. Jacquelyn Martin/AP hide caption The U.S. military attacked a boat accused of smuggling drugs in the eastern Pacific Ocean on Tuesday, killing one man and leaving two survivors, as the Trump administration continues its monthslong campaign against alleged traffickers in Latin America. The latest attack brings the number of people who have been killed in boat strikes by the U.S. military to at least 208 since the Trump administration began targeting those it calls "narcoterrorists" in early September. As with most of the military's statements on strikes in the eastern Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea, U.S. Southern Command said it targeted the alleged drug traffickers along known smuggling routes. The military did not provide evidence that the vessel was ferrying drugs.

articles._zh_summary: 唐纳德·特朗普总统于 2026 年 5 月 27 日星期三在华盛顿举行的白宫内阁会议上发表讲话，国防部长皮特·赫格斯在旁观。杰奎琳·马丁/美联社 隐藏标题 周二，美国军方在东太平洋袭击了一艘被指控走私毒品的船只，造成一名男子死亡，两名幸存者，而特朗普政府仍在继续其长达数月的打击拉丁美洲涉嫌走私毒品的行动。自特朗普政府9月初开始针对​​所谓的“毒品恐怖分子”以来，最新的袭击事件使美国军方在船只袭击中丧生的人数达到至少208人。与大多数军方关于东太平洋和加勒比海袭击的声明一样，美国南方司令部表示，其目标是已知走私路线上的涉嫌毒贩。军方没有提供证据证明该船正在运送毒品。

articles.headline: Trump's Iran Deal Sends Oil Lower, But Americans Are Still Paying More At The Pump, Says Analyst
articles.summary: Gas prices remain high despite Iran deal and falling oil prices. Americans paying $10-$25 more per fill-up compared to last year.
articles._summary: The Iran agreement, touted by President Donald Trump , has sparked optimism as oil prices continue to fall , but the national average price of gas at the pump continues to stay high. In a post on X , GasBuddy analyst Patrick De Haan posted a screenshot of user Hunter Eagleman ‘s post claiming that gas prices had fallen below $3/gallon in a town, without sharing further details. “While Hunter drives across the country for the *cheapest* gas station to post, the average American is spending $10-$25 more every fill-up” when compared to June 2025, De Haan said. Prices were also “over $1/gal more than February,” before a joint U.S.-Israeli operation resulted in the death of Iran’s former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei via a missile strike on February 28, which kick-started the war in Iran.
articles._zh_headline: 分析师称，特朗普的伊朗协议导致油价下跌，但美国人仍在支付更多费用
articles._zh_summary: 随着油价持续下跌，唐纳德·特朗普总统宣扬的伊朗协议引发了乐观情绪，但全国平均天然气价格仍然居高不下。在 X 上的一篇帖子中，GasBuddy 分析师 Patrick De Haan 发布了用户 Hunter Eagleman 帖子的屏幕截图，声称某个城镇的汽油价格已跌破 3 美元/加仑，但没有透露更多细节。德哈恩表示，“虽然亨特开车穿越全国前往*最便宜的”加油站加油，但与 2025 年 6 月相比，美国人平均每次加满油的花费要多 10 至 25 美元。” 2 月 28 日，美国和以色列的联合行动导致伊朗前最高领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊 (Ayatollah Ali Khamenei) 因导弹袭击身亡，伊朗战争由此拉开序幕。

articles.headline: Trump's Iran Peace Deal Could Ignite A 'Relief Rally,' Says Ben Emons, Flags 4 'Cheap' Stocks Beyond Tech
articles.summary: Trump's Middle East ceasefire sparks a market relief rally. FedWatch's Ben Emons reveals 4 cheap value stocks and key AI names to buy now.
articles._summary: The solution for the conflict brings economic benefits, primarily by resolving severe bottlenecks in the Strait of Hormuz . For months, global supply chains faced critical shortages of oil, fertilizer, helium, and aluminum. Emons notes that normalizing the flow of these commodities prevented significant shortages that were only a few weeks away from hitting the market. “I think it’s a true relief rally,” Emons explained in a podcast with Phil Rosen .

articles._zh_summary: 冲突的解决会带来经济利益，主要是通过解决霍尔木兹海峡的严重瓶颈。几个月来，全球供应链面临石油、化肥、氦气和铝的严重短缺。埃蒙斯指出，这些商品的流动正常化避免了距离市场仅几周的严重短缺。 “我认为这是一次真正的缓解集会，”埃蒙斯在菲尔·罗森的播客中解释道。
